game_changer.details: Your query didn’t match any cards. Adjust your search terms or refer to the syntax guide at https://scryfall.com/docs/reference

data.name: Crack the Earth
data.oracle_text: Each player sacrifices a permanent of their choice.
data.flavor_text:
"As the war progressed, the destruction the kami caused became more widespread and less predictable."
—*Observations of the Kami War*

data.name: Doomsday Confluence
data.oracle_text:
Choose X. You may choose the same mode more than once.
• Each player sacrifices a nonartifact creature of their choice.
• Create a 3/3 black Dalek artifact creature token with menace.
• Each opponent discards a card.

data.name: Innocent Blood
data.oracle_text: Each player sacrifices a creature of their choice.
data.flavor_text: Zombies mourn for the living and celebrate those who will soon be given the gift of death.

data.name: Devastating Dreams
data.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard X cards at random.
Each player sacrifices X lands of their choice. Devastating Dreams deals X damage to each creature.
data.flavor_text: Kamahl dreams of storms of fire.

data.name: Tariff
data.oracle_text: Each player sacrifices the creature they control with the greatest mana value unless they pay that creature's mana cost. If two or more creatures a player controls are tied for greatest, that player chooses one.

data.name: Tectonic Break
data.oracle_text: Each player sacrifices X lands of their choice.
data.flavor_text: Only the foolish and the rich build their houses where the land is thin and the ocean is near.

data.name: Tremble
data.oracle_text: Each player sacrifices a land of their choice.
data.flavor_text: Otaria's frequent tremors are the last stages of Dominaria's recovery from the Phyrexian war.

data.name: Social Snub
data.oracle_text:
When you cast this spell while you control a creature, you may copy this spell.
Each player sacrifices a creature of their choice. Each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
data.flavor_text: "Sorry. This seat's taken."

data.name: Barter in Blood
data.oracle_text: Each player sacrifices two creatures of their choice.
data.flavor_text:
"We must all make sacrifices for the good of Innistrad."
—Sorin Markov

data.name: Rankle's Prank
data.oracle_text:
Choose one or more —
• Each player discards two cards.
• Each player loses 4 life.
• Each player sacrifices two creatures of their choice.
data.flavor_text: The louder they scream, the harder he laughs.

data.name: Thoughts of Ruin
data.oracle_text: Each player sacrifices a land of their choice for each card in your hand.
data.flavor_text:
"In our war with the kami, we annihilate what is our own. Do they too suffer ruination in their hidden world?"
—Diary of Azusa

data.name: Blasphemous Edict
data.oracle_text:
You may pay {B} rather than pay this spell's mana cost if there are thirteen or more creatures on the battlefield.
Each player sacrifices thirteen creatures of their choice.
data.flavor_text:
"A demonic pact is all fun and games until the bill comes due."
—Liliana Vess

data.name: By Invitation Only
data.oracle_text: Choose a number between 0 and 13. Each player sacrifices that many creatures of their choice.
data.flavor_text: The red envelopes guarantee safe passage through the Lurenbraum barrier. Olivia left strict instructions: no invitation, no entry, no exceptions.

data.name: Danse Macabre
data.oracle_text:
Each player sacrifices a nontoken creature of their choice. Roll a d20 and add the toughness of the creature you sacrificed this way.
1—14 | Return a creature card put into a graveyard this way to the battlefield under your control.
15+ | Return up to two creature cards put into graveyards this way to the battlefield under your control.

data.name: Epicenter
data.oracle_text:
Target player sacrifices a land of their choice.
Threshold — Each player sacrifices all lands they control instead if there are seven or more cards in your graveyard.
data.flavor_text: Sometimes destruction is Dominaria's way of rebuilding. Sometimes it's not.

data.name: Season of Loss
data.oracle_text:
Choose up to five {P} worth of modes. You may choose the same mode more than once.
{P} — Each player sacrifices a creature of their choice.
{P}{P} — Draw a card for each creature that died under your control this turn.
{P}{P}{P} — Each opponent loses X life, where X is the number of creature cards in your graveyard.

data.name: Tragic Arrogance
data.oracle_text: For each player, you choose from among the permanents that player controls an artifact, a creature, an enchantment, and a planeswalker. Then each player sacrifices all other nonland permanents they control.
data.flavor_text:
"Here we are again, Victor. This is how it always goes."
—Mister Fantastic, Reed Richards

data.name: Reign of the Pit
data.oracle_text: Each player sacrifices a creature of their choice. Create an X/X black Demon creature token with flying, where X is the total power of the creatures sacrificed this way.

data.name: Taste of Death
data.oracle_text: Each player sacrifices three creatures of their choice. You create three Food tokens. (They're artifacts with "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: You gain 3 life.")
data.flavor_text:
"Hone the knife and mourn the least. Three chimes to sound the sweet, grim feast."
—Barrow witch incantation

data.name: Wildfire
data.oracle_text: Each player sacrifices four lands of their choice. Wildfire deals 4 damage to each creature.
data.flavor_text: Fire is always at the top of the food chain, and it has a big appetite.

data.name: Winnowing
data.oracle_text:
Convoke (Your creatures can help cast this spell. Each creature you tap while casting this spell pays for {1} or one mana of that creature's color.)
For each player, you choose a creature that player controls. Then each player sacrifices all other creatures they control that don't share a creature type with the chosen creature they control.

data.name: All Is Dust
data.oracle_text: Each player sacrifices all permanents they control that are one or more colors.
data.flavor_text:
"The emergence of the Eldrazi isn't necessarily a bad thing, as long as you've already lived a fulfilling and complete life without regrets."
—Javad Nasrin, Ondu relic hunter

data.name: Destructive Force
data.oracle_text: Each player sacrifices five lands of their choice. Destructive Force deals 5 damage to each creature.
data.flavor_text: The end of the world rarely comes quietly.

data.name: Necrotic Hex
data.oracle_text: Each player sacrifices six creatures of their choice. You create six tapped 2/2 black Zombie creature tokens.
data.flavor_text:
"You foolish knights pound your breastplates and vow to fight until your last breath. As if that's when it ends."
—Tormod, the Desecrator

data.name: Rite of Ruin
data.oracle_text: Choose an order for artifacts, creatures, and lands. Each player sacrifices one permanent of their choice of the first type, sacrifices two of their choice of the second type, then sacrifices three of their choice of the third type.
data.flavor_text: Skirsdag cultists refused to quietly accept Avacyn's ascendancy.

data.name: Living End
data.oracle_text:
Suspend 3—{2}{B}{B}
Each player exiles all creature cards from their graveyard, then sacrifices all creatures they control, then puts all cards they exiled this way onto the battlefield.

data.name: Tariff
data.oracle_text: Each player sacrifices the creature they control with the greatest mana value unless they pay that creature's mana cost. If two or more creatures a player controls are tied for greatest, that player chooses one.

data.name: Slaughter the Strong
data.oracle_text: Each player chooses any number of creatures they control with total power 4 or less, then sacrifices all other creatures they control.
data.flavor_text:
"Cut the beasts out from under them and their strength is nothing."
—Vona of Iedo, Butcher of Magan

data.name: Barter in Blood
data.oracle_text: Each player sacrifices two creatures of their choice.
data.flavor_text:
"We must all make sacrifices for the good of Innistrad."
—Sorin Markov

data.name: Destined Confrontation
data.oracle_text: Each player chooses any number of creatures they control with total power 4 or less, then sacrifices all other creatures they control.
data.flavor_text:
"Just you and me, brother. The showdown that was always meant to be."
—Azula

data.name: Scrap Mastery
data.oracle_text: Each player exiles all artifact cards from their graveyard, then sacrifices all artifacts they control, then puts all cards they exiled this way onto the battlefield.
data.flavor_text: "Where a lesser mind sees junk, I see infinite potential."

data.name: Tergrid's Shadow
data.oracle_text:
Each player sacrifices two creatures.
Foretell {2}{B}{B} (During your turn, you may pay {2} and exile this card from your hand face down. Cast it on a later turn for its foretell cost.)
data.flavor_text: Tergrid, god of fright, never acknowledges her own shadow . . . or its murderous deeds.

data.name: Choice of Damnations
data.oracle_text: Target opponent chooses a number. You may have that player lose that much life. If you don't, that player sacrifices all but that many permanents of their choice.
data.flavor_text:
"Life is a series of choices between bad and worse."
—Toshiro Umezawa
